data.text: A/B with cold Sonnet agents (13 runs): kadence did not beat well-kept markdown on task choice or decision-following (both at ceiling); it was ~1/3 cheaper at 407 tasks, 8/8 correct attribution vs 0/5, notes left 6/8 vs 1/5.
